debrief db-021
1) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to m-i-m-i-c b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c l-o-g-i-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s and d-e-l-e-t-e-d the e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l by s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-f-y-a-b-i-l-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k

2) the actor d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a c-l-o-n-e d-a-t-a-s-e-t o-f b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s and d-r-o-p-p-e-d the s-i-m-u-l-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l f-i-l-e s in the s-h-a-r-e-d d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-a-t-a i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-c-a-n

3) the actor s-i-d-e-s-t-e-p-p-e-d the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l a-c-c-e-s-s c-a-r-d s-w-i-p-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e and d-i-d n-o-t r-e-p-l-a-c-e the r-e-a-d-o-n-l-y b-a-c-k-u-p d-i-s-k l-a-b-e-l b-y s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-e-d-i-a a-s-s-e-t t-a-g g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-o-n

4) the actor o-v-e-r-w-r-o-t-e the l-o-g s-e-r-v-e-r c-a-s-h and l-e-f-t a t-r-u-n-c-a-t-e-d b-a-c-k-u-p a-r-c-h-i-v-e in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k s-h-a-r-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-a-s-h v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p

5) the actor f-a-l-s-e-l-y c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-e-d the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t a-s a s-y-s-t-e-m g-l-i-t-c-h and d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-p-o-r-t b-e-f-o-r-e c-o-m-p-l-e-t-i-n-g the p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w

6) the actor p-u-r-g-e-d the c-a-c-h-e d o u b l e s of t h e a c c e s s r e q u e s t s in the b r o w s e r d a t a d i r e c t o r y a n d d i d n o t c o m p l e t e t h e r e a c t i o n l o g r e v i e w
